question:
The value of

\[\dfrac{1}{10} + \dfrac{2}{20} + \dfrac{3}{30}\]

is
solution:
Reduce the fractions first so that all three terms are expressed in tenths. Dividing the numerator and denominator of \(2/20\) by \(2\), and those of \(3/30\) by \(3\), gives
\[
\frac1{10}+\frac2{20}+\frac3{30}
=\frac1{10}+\frac1{10}+\frac1{10}
=\frac3{10}=0.3.
\]
The answer is \(\boxed{\text{D}}\).
